cohort: The study included 676 postpartum women who were interviewed shortly after childbirth in a hospital in the Northeast region in the State of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
finding: The high cesarean section rates identified in this study were mainly associated with having had a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: The prevalence of cesarean sections was 58.7%, with factors like previous cesarean section, source of childbirth/prenatal care financing, and the healthcare professional associated with the route of birth delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from January to May 2017, with women interviewed shortly after childbirth in the maternity.
